purpose: Locate the library. The prompt names the Articles database but not its id, and titles repeat in this workspace, so the id has to be looked up rather than assumed.
name: notion-search

purpose: Hydrate the database id that s1 returned. This is the only call that yields the data source url the SQL tool needs (collection://ds-...) and the column names behind it; the database id itself is not a usable table name.
name: notion-fetch

purpose: One SQL read over the data source url s2 returned: every article row with its title, its Doc stage and its url. The url is where the 18 page ids come from - SQL refuses to return an id column on this connector - so every per-page read below depends on this result. Nothing about comments or discussions is in this table.
name: notion-query-data-sources

data.query: SELECT url, "Title", "Doc stage" FROM "collection://ds-9caee280db7e4c9385908af1164446fb" ORDER BY "Title"

purpose: Open the reviewer threads on Antenatal Testing, whose page id came from the url column of s3. include_all_blocks is required or this page reports zero discussions, and include_resolved is required or a settled thread is invisible. The resolved flag this returns is the finding every graded figure turns on and it exists nowhere else on the surface.
